The '''Swamp Ginx''' was an aggressive species of [[ginx]] native to the [[Zakuul]]. It was an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] found in the marches of the [[Endless Swamp]]. It had unique among the ginx elongated horizontal pupils.<ref name="swamp ginx" />
